title: Clear the fog
summary: Five minutes of simple focus for days when your thinking feels slow or scattered.

segments.text: Some days your mind feels like it's moving through fog. This session won't force it to clear. It gives your attention one simple place to rest.
Sit in a way that feels upright but not stiff. Let your hands rest wherever they're comfortable.
We'll count breaths together. Breathe in, and as you breathe out, silently count one.
Breathe in again, and on the out breath, two.
Keep going like this, up to five. Then start again at one.
If you lose count, that's not a mistake. It's the practice. Notice you drifted, and start again at one.
Keep counting, one to five, at your own pace.
Now let the counting go. Look around the room and name, silently, five things you can see.
Pick one of them. Notice its color, its edges, how the light falls on it. Stay with it for a few breaths.
Now bring your attention back to your breath. One breath in, one breath out.
Before you move on, choose one small thing to do next. Just one. Hold it in your mind.
When you're ready, open your eyes if they were closed, and begin with that one thing.
